journey.title: Set up an identity worth trusting
journey.purpose: Bring a persona from nothing to genuinely usable. The journey is deliberately front-loaded with the legal basis, because everything downstream asserts it and it can never be edited afterwards.

steps.intent: Understand that a persona represents a real person or entity, not a throwaway account.
Create the persona by declaring its kind and its legal basis as a deliberate statement.
See plainly what is still missing before this identity can be used for anything.
Confirm the persona can receive mail and codes, points at the documents it needs, and names who may act as it.
steps.via: Bind a channel, bind documents, and set the ACL.
